translations.text: "The angel Gabriel was sent," and so on.
Yet Almighty God took pity on the miseries of all mankind, and considered how he might redeem his handiwork from the devil's power;
The prophecies about Christ's birth and about the blessed Mary's virginity are set down in many ways in the Old Law, and whoever wishes to study them will find them there in great abundance.
The apostle Paul also said, "When the fullness of time came, God the Father sent his Son for the redemption of mankind."
Then Joseph, as the angel had commanded him, took care of both Mary and the child, and was her witness that she was a virgin,
and he was Christ's foster-father, and served him in his human nature with his help and comfort in all things.
Truly she was filled with God's grace, because it was granted to her that she should bear the one who established all graces and all truths.
Then the angel answered the maiden, "The Holy Spirit will come upon you from above, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you." Through the working of the Holy Spirit,
as we said before, Christ was conceived in human nature; and Mary his mother was overshadowed through the power of the Holy Spirit. How was she overshadowed?
and he was holy at once, as soon as he was man, and perfect God, the Son of Almighty God, man and God in one person.
So our Saviour came into Mary's womb on this day, which is called Annuntiatio Sanctae Mariae, that is, the Day of Mary's Annunciation;

and she carried him until the feast-day of Midwinter (Christmas), and then gave birth to him in true human nature, he who was always dwelling in the Godhead with his Father and with the Holy Spirit, the three of them one indivisible God.
Now the evangelist says that Mary, after the angel's announcement, went to her kinswoman Elizabeth, who was the wife of Zechariah.
They were both righteous, and kept God's commandments blamelessly. They were without a child until they were worn out with age.
Then the same angel Gabriel came to Zechariah six months before he came to Mary, and announced that he would have a son by his old wife, John the Baptist.
But he did not believe the angel's message. Then the angel said to him, "Since you will not believe my words, be mute until the child is born."
and she cried out to Mary in a loud voice and said, "You are blessed among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb. How has it happened to me that the mother of my Lord should come to me?"
She said, "Blessed are you, Mary, because you believed the words that were announced to you from God, and it will be accomplished just as it was made known to you."
The blessed Mary sprang from the line of Abraham, and from Mary came Christ in his human nature, and through Christ all the faithful are blessed.
We are not of Abraham's line in the flesh, but spiritually, as the apostle Paul said, "Truly, if you are Christians, then you are Abraham's offspring, and heirs according to the promise."
